typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) = 1 	THEN \'Filename,LineNumber,MessageId,MessageDesc,LogDesc\' + CHAR(10) 	ELSE \'\' END 	+ ISNULL(SUBSTRING(JF.PathFileName,2+LEN(JF.PathFileName)-CHARINDEX(\'\\\',REVERSE(JF.PathFileName)),LEN(JF.PathFileName)),\'\') 	+ \',\' + ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(WSIL.LineNumber))),\'\') 	+ \',\' + ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(WSIL.MessageId))),\'\') 	+ \',\' + \'"\' + ISNULL(REPLACE(M.MessageDesc,\'"\',\'""\'),\'\') + \'"\' 	+ \',\' + \'"\' + ISNULL(REPLACE(WSIL.LogDesc,\'"\',\'""\'),\'\') + \'"\' AS PrintLine FROM EPSDTWellServicesInputLog WSIL INNER JOIN EPSDTJobFile JF ON JF.JobFileId = WSIL.JobFileId INNER JOIN EPSDTMessage M ON M.MessageId = WSIL.MessageId WHERE WSIL.JobId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PrintLine as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PrintLine)) ~> FlatFileDestination
